warmup: initial full load; complete derived snapshot populated before each early-revision commit, outside timing; p99 over 1000 changes per probe
memory: live heap via stats_alloc counting allocator (requested bytes; allocator metadata excluded); category lower bounds checked by tests/memory_accounting.rs; per-scope upper bound = lower + untracked; RSS reported only; no payload bodies stored
store: StdDisk on APFS (internal SSD), temp dir; fullfsync on = F_FULLFSYNC via sync_all, off = fsync(2) via nix (measurement only); SQLite projections in memory for bench
commit_probe: single-transaction commit through Store::commit including frame append + sync, p99 over 1000 samples
